testcase.name: 1. users & clubs: self-bootstrap user allowed, self-privilege-escalation denied, admin cannot change own role, admin manages clubs without hard-delete
2. events: staff manages own club events (create/update/archive), cross-club staff & user writes denied, hard delete denied
3. Cross-Role Flow 1 (registrations + notifications): student submits pending -> staff approves/rejects atomically -> cross-club & over-capacity blocked
4. Cross-Role Flow 2 (checkinSessions + qrCredentials): staff opens QR session, approved student checks in once, rotated/closed QR & pending check-in denied
5. announcements & push receipts: staff publishes club announcement, cross-club/global/user writes denied, private push receipts enforced
archived event stays readable only to its registrant or club staff
legacy mobile active registration without clubId can cancel atomically once
legacy ownerless events cannot create a new direct registration in ASM
pending withdrawal preserves seats and a new request resets review state
report metadata is owner-only, shaped, immutable and contains no file URL
announcement read receipts belong only to their reader and require a real announcement
unpublished events stay private; staff submits but cannot publish or impersonate another club
